Original rematch/suicide route replaced by secure custody, separation from weapon fragments and initial interrogation. Vartox remains alive and bargains/refuses; weapon findings and final prosecution unresolved.
Following-day James rooftop explanation and Kryptonian-blanket cape have not occurred; no full-pilot completion claimed.
Astra ending responds to missed check-in and observed human cleanup rather than original Vartox defeat report; she orders captor identification, unaware of Kael’s intervention.
